mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, leading to decreased corporate borrowing and investment, which negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns despite high FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive despite rising UNRATE, the hypothesis fails.

failure_condition: Positive S&P 500 returns despite the joint condition would falsify this.
